recommended_paths: Keep the checkpoint pending. Add direct MetaHttpClient tests for: a missing debug data object; non-string app_id; non-boolean is_valid; a valid grant with scopes omitted but required granular scopes present; and a valid irrelevant granular entry with target_ids omitted. Each malformed case should assert the typed failure and exactly one fetch; each valid-omission case should assert successful bounded verification. Then create a fresh source freeze, run the canonical full all suite, repeat this fresh test-quality audit, and send the resulting package to the separate final-review gate. No production behavior change is indicated by this finding.
exact_next_step: Record reviewer resolutions in the governing TODO using the machine-checkable resolution table or equivalent gate ledger, then extract the derived resolution packet and decide whether another bounded review pass is still required.

findings.title: Grant-shape tests omit required scalar and legitimate-omission cases
findings.rationale: The parser in api-app/src/integrations/meta/meta.client.ts rejects a missing or malformed debug-grant root, app_id, and is_valid, while intentionally allowing omitted optional scopes, granular_scopes, and target_ids. The frozen tests cover malformed scopes, granular_scopes, and target_ids, but do not directly cover missing data, malformed app_id, malformed is_valid, or valid omission of scopes with required granular scope authorization. A regression could therefore reject a legitimate provider grant or weaken scalar validation without failing the current focused matrix. This is a boundary-contract coverage gap, not an observed production behavior defect.
findings.suggested_action: Extend the Meta client table tests with the missing negative scalar cases and positive optional-field omission cases. Assert typed error identity and one fetch for malformed debug responses, and successful bounded verification for valid omission variants; then rerun the canonical full suite and fresh audit.
